> **As of 2026-10-29.** Operator seats are the long-lived Claude sessions that run the build fleet from Joe's laptop ([[Carbon]]): three unit-driven seats (`ctl` controller, `rb`, `r7`) that wake as `claude -p --resume <sid>` turns, plus the `aide`, Joe's interactive channel (and its lanes). All four are Opus 5.5; Fable is only spawned for one-turn reviews. The seat table is `~/.claude/state/seats.tsv`; live tick state is `~/.cache/fleet-dash/<seat>-tick.json`; the operator card printed at SessionStart (10-29 3:12 PM) shows per-seat correction share, floor p50 and timers. Per-seat pages: [[Controller Seat]], [[RB Seat]], [[R7 Seat]], [[Aide Seat]]; the bare-`claude` case is [[Plain Carbon Session]].
